title: I let coding agents build my 3D models through Blender scripts instead of using asset generators. Here's how that went
author: Dull-Ad-4826
selftext:
Plumki is a browser physics game based on a real outdoor game similar to flunkyball. You swing a stick, knock the bottles over and race your opponent. I've been building it for about a month through Claude Code and Codex.

The unusual part: I didn't use image or mesh generators. Every model in the game is built by a Python script for Blender that the agent wrote (around 160 scripts so far). Everything stays editable and consistent, and "make the stick 20% chunkier" is a one-line request. 

Opus 5.5 is GOAT at model creation, I've started with Astra and since then rebuilt almost every model with Opus.

Free in the browser, solo works without an account: [https://plumki.games](https://plumki.games/) (optional cosmetic packs only).
